text:
Introduction
This document lists the
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases bases as indicated by Y1
in the above title block.
This 
checklist for the operating mechanism of the circuit 
breaker type: AM-13.8-750-5, rated voltage 11.5kv
This document initiated and tested by by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Ezzy, reviewed by eng Marcas Estasious Condis, revised by EDEPC quality control 
eng. Tawfeq Al Abasery, approved by operation and 
maintenance's General Director: eng. Nabel Al Bastawesy, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection and quality control head 
sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Safety and healthy 
 tools must be used as safety Helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Switch off input and output 
 supply
Generator 
 must be fully isolated
Circuit breaker for generator 
 must be isolated and grounded.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Digital voltmeter, 
 megger
Brush, vacuum cleaner 
 or air blower
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the
 mating surfaces of the metal clad.
Check the racking mechanism to ensure it is in the 
 disconnection position.
Check the voltage control at the power source and check 
 that there is no line drop between the power source and the breaker.
